name: load-bearing capacity
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 基础或构件承受荷载的能力。

complete_examples.text: Experiments were conducted to measure the load-bearing capacity and stiffness degradation of the tunnel basement structure under different defect states.
Under wet conditions, the load-bearing capacity of the specimens (TC-2) is slightly higher (5.69 kN) than that of the dry specimens (5.54 kN).
